jamb-biology-mock-0001.explanation: Mitochondria carry out respiration and release energy (ATP), hence 'powerhouse'.

jamb-biology-mock-0002.explanation: All living things are made of cells, the basic structural and functional unit.

jamb-biology-mock-0003.explanation: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water to make glucose, releasing oxygen.

jamb-biology-mock-0004.explanation: Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs light energy.

jamb-biology-mock-0006.explanation: Mendel's pea experiments founded the science of genetics.

jamb-biology-mock-0007.explanation: Only homozygous SS individuals express sickle cell disease; AS and AC are carriers.

jamb-biology-mock-0008.explanation: The liver produces bile, which the gall bladder stores.

jamb-biology-mock-0009.explanation: Group O red cells carry no A or B antigens, so they can be given to any group.

jamb-biology-mock-0010.explanation: Transpiration is water loss mainly through the stomata of leaves.

jamb-biology-mock-0011.explanation: Air enters the insect tracheal system through spiracles.

jamb-biology-mock-0012.explanation: The skin covers the whole body and is the largest organ by area.

jamb-biology-mock-0013.explanation: Rhizobium lives symbiotically in the root nodules of leguminous plants.

jamb-biology-mock-0014.explanation: Mushrooms are saprophytic fungi, not plants.

jamb-biology-mock-0015.explanation: Lack of vitamin C (ascorbic acid) causes scurvy, marked by bleeding gums and poor wound healing.
